MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: 1) The space left between the margin and the start of a paragraph is called-
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp: Indentation is the space left between the 'margin' and the 'start of paragraph'. The term indentation or indent is used for describing the number of blank spaces or the distance utilized for separation of paragraph from the right or left margins.

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: 2) Text-styling feature of MS word is-
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp: The text styling feature of MS Word is known as WordArt. It allows users to make the text more noticeable and more flashy.

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: 3) To apply center alignment to a paragraph we can press-
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp: To apply center alignment to a paragraph we can press Ctrl + E.

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: 4) Which feature starts a new line whenever a word or sentence reaches a border?
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
Text Wrapping is the feature starts a new line whenever a word or sentence reaches a border in Ms-word.
The border can be of any image or the text editor, By default the text will automatically steer around the blank spaces.
It is basically used to surround any image or diagram or graph with text.

6) Which feature helps you to insert the contents of the clipboard as text without any formatting?

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: 7) Which is a collection of predefined design elements and color scheme?
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp: Themes provide a complete design for our document, including background designs, font styles, colors, and layouts.

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: 8) Which operation will you perform if you need to move a block of text?
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
1. Select the text that you want to move, and then press CTRL + X (cut) to move the text.
2. Click where you want to paste the text, and then press CTRL + V (paste).

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: 9) In MS Word you can detect spelling and Grammar errors by-
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp: F7 is commonly used to spell check and grammar check a document in Microsoft programs such as Microsoft Word, Outlook, etc.

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: 10) Which key is used to break the current column?
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp: Ctrl + Shift + Enter key is used to break the current column.

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: 11) Background color or effects applied on a document is not visible in-
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp: Background color or effects applied on a document is not visible in the Print Preview area.

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: 12) In MS Word, Ctrl + R is used to align the text to the ______ of the screen.

In MS Word, Ctrl + R is used to align the text to the right of the screen.
Ctrl + Q - Align selected paragraph to the left.
Ctrl + E - Align selected text or line to the center.

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: 16) The convenient place to store contact information for quick retrieval in an email is-
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
• An address book or a name and address book (NAB) is a book or a database utilized for putting away sections called contacts. Each contact section, for the most part, comprises a couple of standard fields (for instance: first name, last name, organization name, address, phone number, email address, fax number, cell phone number).
• Address box: The address box is a pane in the browser window of Internet Explorer that holds the current document's URL. You can type a URL in this box and press Enter to access a Web page. See also the location field.
• Message box: A message box is a special type of Visual Basic window in which you can display a message to the user. You can display a message, an optional icon, a title bar caption, and command buttons in a message box.
• Message book: A message book is a book that contains messages. It doesn't provide a scope to modify or change the messages.

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: 17) Which of the following is an email software?
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp: Microsoft Outlook: It is an application that is used mainly to send and receive emails.

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: 19) E-KYC is a/an-
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
KYC is the abbreviation of Know Your Customer. Financial institutions such as banks and Non-Banking Finance Companies have mandated KYC regulations before providing any financial service to customers.
KYC is done with the purpose of establishing the identity and verifying the credentials of any customer. The eKYC process, often called paperless KYC, is the process of electronically verifying the credentials of a customer.

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: 20) Which of the following protocols uses both TCP and UDP?
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp: DNS uses TCP for zone exchanges between servers and UDP when a client is trying to resolve a hostname to an IP address.

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: 21) POP3 is a protocol for-
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp: Email গ্রহণ করার প্রটোকল হল POP3 (Post Office Protocol)। এই প্রটোকল ইমেইল গ্রহণ করে সার্ভারে জমা করে রাখার জন্য ব্যবহৃত হয়।

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: 22) MICR technology is used in bank to:
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
Magnetic ink character recognition (MICR) is a technology used primarily to identify and process checks.
The MICR on a check is the string of characters that appears at the bottom left of the check. It consists of three groups of numbers, including the bank routing number, the account number, and the check number.
Source: Investopedia.com

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: 23) Email uses which of the following layers?
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
OSI models have seven layers and the top most layer is Application Layer. Application Layer having two protocol names ''SMTP'' (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol) and “POP3” (Post Office Protocol v3);
These two protocols are used for sending and receiving emails respectively.

MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.question: 30) What is on-demand mail relay (ODMR)?
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.option4: ঘ) protocol for faster mail transfer
MS Office, Email, Internet usage, Bank R.exp:
ODMR is an extension to SMTP, in which mails are relayed to the receivers after they are authenticated.
It allows only the authorized receivers to receive the mail.
